title: Earliest Time to Finish One Task
summary: Given a 2D integer array tasks where each entry consists of a start time si and a duration ti , find the earliest time at which any task completes.
statement: Given a 2D integer array tasks where each entry consists of a start time si and a duration ti , find the earliest time at which any task completes.
constraints: Each task record contains its start time and duration.
A task finishes at start plus duration.
Return the earliest finish time among all tasks.
reference_solution:
def earliest_task_finish_time(tasks):
    return min(start+duration for start,duration in tasks)
hints: Every task is independent for this question.
The minimum computed finish is exactly the earliest possible completion.
editorial: The minimum computed finish is exactly the earliest possible completion.

tests.explanation: The tasks finish at seven and five, so the earliest time is five.
The only task finishes at time six.
